Junior Java Backend Developer (Fresher)
We are hiring a junior backend developer to build REST APIs with Java and Spring Boot.
You will design MySQL schemas, write unit tests with JUnit and Mockito, and deploy services with Docker on AWS.
Requirements: strong Java and OOP fundamentals, data structures and algorithms, SQL, Git.
Nice to have: Kafka, microservices, CI/CD with Jenkins. You will join code reviews and work in an Agile team.
